tailoring.headline: Techno-Functional Digital Business Analyst | SAP Commerce Cloud & API Integration Specialist
tailoring.summary: Techno-functional Business Analyst and SAP Commerce Cloud Developer with 5+ years of experience delivering enterprise B2B/B2C solutions. Expert in translating complex business requirements into technical specifications, user stories, and API documentation. Proven track record in PIM/ERP/MDM integration, API lifecycle management, and agile delivery. Highly proficient in using AI-assisted tools for requirements analysis, gap detection, and documentation. SAP Certified Professional with a strong focus on quality, stakeholder alignment, and scalable digital architecture.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: Digital Business Analyst
cover_en.hook: As a techno-functional expert with over 5 years of experience building enterprise e-commerce platforms at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I am eager to contribute to simplesurance’s mission of integrating innovative insurance technology. My background in bridging the gap between complex business requirements and scalable technical delivery aligns perfectly with your team's focus on driving digital transformation.

bullets.label: Requirements & User Stories
bullets.text: I have extensive experience partnering with business stakeholders to translate roadmap priorities into clear, delivery-ready user stories and functional specifications for SAP Commerce Cloud solutions.

bullets.label: API Specification & Design
bullets.text: I have designed and exposed OCC REST Web Services and headless APIs, ensuring clear documentation for endpoints, request/response models, and business rules to support seamless integration.

bullets.label: Validation & Quality
bullets.text: I lead UAT and validation processes, ensuring delivered features and API integrations strictly meet business requirements, acceptance criteria, and edge-case handling.

bullets.label: AI-Driven Delivery
bullets.text: I utilize generative AI and LLM tools to accelerate requirements analysis, detect gaps in logic, and maintain high-quality, consistent technical documentation.

cover_en.gap: My deep experience in designing data flows and API integrations for complex PIM/ERP/MDM ecosystems provides a robust foundation for managing the sophisticated digital workflows at simplesurance.
cover_en.logistics: I am based in Karlsruhe and hold a valid German residence and work permit. I am currently serving a notice period and will be available to start on 16 December 2026. I look forward to discussing how my background can support your team.

tailoring.why_company: I am drawn to simplesurance because of your unique position at the intersection of insurance and digital ecosystems. Your motto 'Never Stop Playing' resonates with my approach to innovation, and I am impressed by your commitment to scalable B2B/B2C solutions. I want to bring my expertise in complex API integrations and techno-functional analysis to a team that is actively shaping the future of insurtech.
tailoring.motivation_short: I am motivated by the challenge of translating complex business needs into robust, scalable technical solutions. I thrive in agile, international environments and am eager to apply my experience in API-driven e-commerce to the innovative insurtech landscape at simplesurance.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hi Yigit, I am a techno-functional Business Analyst with 5+ years of experience in API-driven enterprise platforms. I’ve followed simplesurance’s growth in the insurtech space and would love to contribute to your team. My CV and cover letter are attached.
tailoring.email_subject: Application: Digital Business Analyst - Kranti Chavan
tailoring.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

Please find attached my CV and cover letter for the Digital Business Analyst position at simplesurance. With over 5 years of experience in techno-functional roles, I specialize in translating complex business requirements into clear API specifications and scalable technical solutions. My background in agile delivery and AI-assisted analysis aligns well with your team's goals. I am available to start on 16 December 2026 and would welcome the opportunity to discuss how my experience can support your upcoming projects.
